title: 第三十六章 冰原上的脚印-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一

    越往北飞，天越矮。

    云层压得很低，灰白色的，像一床发霉的棉被。灵鹤飞进去，翅膀上结了冰碴，每一次拍打都发出细微的碎裂声，像有人在嚼冰糖。苏棠把斗篷裹紧。呼出的白气在面前凝成一团雾，又被风吹散。

    沈夜白坐在她身后。一只手揽着她的腰，另一只手按在剑柄上。他的体温隔着几层衣料传过来，是这片冰冷天地中唯一的热源。

    胖橘缩在包袱里，只露出一截尾巴尖。毛被风吹成一团蒲公英。小青龙躲在荷包里，连头都不敢探出来——龙族不惧严寒，但幼龙的身体还不够强壮。

    小雪躲在剑里，偶尔飘出来看一眼冰天雪地，又赶紧缩回去。

    小棠，还有多远？

    顾衍的灵力波形越来越弱。方向明确——正北偏西，约八百里。极北之地没有灵气补充，他在消耗自身。速度在变慢，体力在下降。建议加速。

    灵鹤已经飞了两天两夜，中途只休息一次。翅膀在发抖。苏棠拍拍它的脖子：快了。

    它又振作起来，拼命拍打翅膀。

    苏棠心疼灵鹤，但不能停。顾衍在冰原上，一个人，没有补给，没有补天镜，没有锚点力量。

    他凭什么去捡碎片？用拳头砸？用牙咬？

    沈夜白，你说顾衍为什么要一个人去？

    沈夜白想了想。因为他不想连累别人。前半辈子一直在跑，不想让别人为他冒险。后半辈子——习惯改不了。

    苏棠咬了咬嘴唇。顾衍这个人，嘴上说我不跑了，心里还是一样。遇到危险，第一反应是把别人推开。

    她攥紧手里的玉瓶。瓶中的生命灵泉温温热热，贴着手心，像一块刚出炉的松饼，持续地、稳定地发着热。

    二

    八百里，灵鹤又飞了三个时辰。

    脚下的丘陵变成荒原，荒原变成冻土，冻土变成冰盖。冰面上有裂纹，不是直的，是弯曲的，像有人用指甲在玻璃上乱划。裂纹里透出暗红色的光——不是血，是碎片。

    小棠，顾衍在哪里？

    前方约五十里。灵力波形已非常微弱，但还在移动。速度很慢，像在步行。

    五十里。苏棠拍拍灵鹤的脖子。灵鹤发出疲惫的鸣叫，但还是加快速度。

    冰原上没有任何生命迹象。没有树，没有草，没有鸟。连风都停了。万籁俱寂，只剩下灵鹤翅膀拍打的声音和苏棠自己的心跳。

    胖橘从包袱里探出头，鼻子在空气中嗅了嗅。

    老板，有铁锈味。很淡，但很新鲜。

    苏棠的心猛地一沉。

    灵鹤降落在冰面上。苏棠跳下来，脚踩在冰上，滑了一下。沈夜白扶住她胳膊。

    地面上有脚印——不是灵鹤的，是人的。脚印不深，但很清晰，朝北延伸。脚印旁边有暗红色斑点。苏棠蹲下来，用手指碰了一下——是冰面太薄，碎片的光从底下透上来，照在冰面上，像血。胖橘闻到的不是血腥味，是碎片能量外泄时产生的气味，像铁锈。

    碎片。沈夜白的声音低沉，冰面下有碎片。不止一块。

    苏棠用锚点力量感知。冰层下，约十丈深的地方，散落着至少七八块。大小不一，有的像拳头，有的像西瓜。它们被冰封住了，没有坠落，没有伤人，但能量在缓慢释放，温暖了冰层，导致裂纹出现。

    顾衍的脚印朝着碎片方向延伸，但到了某个位置就断了——不是消失，是被什么东西拖拽过。

    苏棠顺着拖拽痕迹看去。冰面上有一条长长的、弯曲的拖痕，像有人被拖着往前走。拖痕尽头是一个冰洞——冰层塌陷形成的洞口，黑漆漆的，看不见底。

    他掉下去了。

    沈夜白走到洞口，蹲下来，用手摸冰洞边缘。边缘是湿的，有水——不是融化的冰，是冰层下面，的水被碎片能量加热了。

    苏棠趴在洞口边，朝下面喊：顾衍——！

    回声在冰洞中回荡。一下，两下，三下。

    然后，一个微弱的声音从深处传上来。断断续续，像风中的蛛丝。

    苏……棠……？

    苏棠的拳头攥紧了，指节发白。她没有哭，但眼眶发热。

    顾衍！你等着！我下来救你！

    别……下来……冰……要塌了……

    顾衍的声音很虚弱，但还在努力说完整的话。

    碎片……在下面……很多……我……捡到了……一些……

    苏棠站起来，擦了擦眼睛。她转向沈夜白。

    我下去。你在上面接应。

    沈夜白按住她的手。我下去。你在上面，用锚点力量稳住冰层。碎片在吸收能量，只有你能控制。

    苏棠想反驳，但沈夜白的眼神拦住了她。不是霸道，是认真——他说的有道理。

    冰层已经很脆弱，碎片被激活后开始吸收周围一切能量。如果苏棠也下去，没有人控制锚点力量，冰层会彻底崩塌。

    她点了点头，把腰间的一捆绳子解下来，递给沈夜白。绳子是白芷塞进包袱里的，说万一用得着。白芷总是对的。

    沈夜白把绳子系在腰间，另一端系在苏棠腰上。他看了她一眼，没有说别担心，只是轻轻握了一下她的手。

    然后转身滑进了冰洞。

    苏棠趴在洞口，看着他的白色身影在黑暗中越来越小。小雪从剑里飘出来，小手抓着苏棠的衣领，浅蓝眼睛里满是紧张。胖橘蹲在苏棠脚边，尾巴卷着她的脚踝。小青龙从荷包里探出头，金瞳盯着洞口。

    小棠，稳定冰层。

    正在输入锚点力量。冰层结构在加固，但碎片在吸收能量，速度在加快。

    苏棠跪在冰面上，双手按在冰层上。金色的光芒从掌心渗入冰中，像树根一样向四周蔓延。冰层的裂纹停止扩大，边缘的水重新凝结成冰。

    她能感觉到沈夜白在冰洞中的位置——约三十丈深处。他用剑气在冰壁上凿出落脚点，一级一级往下。剑气消耗很大，但他没停。

    胖橘的耳朵竖了起来。

    老板，下面的碎片在移动！

    苏棠也感觉到了。碎片不是静止的，它们在冰层下的水中漂移，像鱼一样游动。顾衍掉下去时砸碎冰层，碎片被震动激活，开始吸收周围能量——包括苏棠的锚点力量。

    沈夜白！碎片在向你靠近！

    回声在冰洞中回荡。几秒钟后，沈夜白的声音从深处传上来，带着一丝少见的急促：
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

1

The further north you fly, the lower the sky becomes.

The clouds were very low, gray and white, like a moldy quilt.The crane flew in, its wings were covered with ice, and every time it flapped, it made a tiny cracking sound, like someone chewing rock candy.Su Tang wrapped her cloak tightly.The white breath he exhaled condensed into a mist in front of him, and was blown away by the wind.

Shen Yebai sat behind her.One hand was around her waist, and the other was on the hilt of the sword.His body temperature passed through several layers of clothing and was the only source of heat in this cold world.

Fat Orange was shrunk in the baggage, with only the tip of its tail exposed.The hair was blown into a dandelion ball by the wind.The little green dragon hid in the purse, not even daring to poke his head out - dragons are not afraid of severe cold, but the young dragon's body is not strong enough.

Xiaoxue hid in the sword, occasionally floating out to take a look at the ice and snow, and then quickly retracted.

Xiaotang, how far is it?

Gu Yan's spiritual power waveform is getting weaker and weaker.The direction is clear - due north by west, about 800 miles.There is no spiritual energy replenishment in the far north, he is consuming himself.The speed is slowing down and the physical strength is decreasing.It is recommended to speed up.

The crane has been flying for two days and two nights, resting only once.The wings are trembling.Su Tang patted its neck: It's almost here.

It cheered up again and flapped its wings desperately.

Su Tang felt sorry for Linghe, but couldn't stop.Gu Yan was alone on the ice field, with no supplies, no sky patching mirror, and no anchor strength.

Why should he pick up the pieces?Hit it with your fist?Bite with your teeth?

Shen Yebai, why do you think Gu Yan wants to go alone?

Shen Yebai thought for a while.Because he doesn't want to hurt others.He has been running for the first half of his life, not wanting others to take risks for him.For the rest of your life—you can’t change your habits.

Su Tang bit her lip.Gu Yan said I won't run away, but he still felt the same in his heart.When faced with danger, the first reaction is to push others away.

She clenched the jade bottle in her hand.The life spring in the bottle is warm and close to the palm of your hand, like a piece of freshly baked muffin, continuously and steadily generating heat.

2

Eight hundred miles away, the crane flew for another three hours.

The hills beneath our feet turned into wasteland, the wasteland turned into frozen soil, and the frozen soil turned into ice caps.There are cracks on the ice, which are not straight but curved, like someone scratching the glass with their fingernails.Dark red light came from the cracks—not blood, but fragments.

Xiaotang, where is Gu Yan?

It’s about fifty miles ahead.The spiritual power waveform is very weak, but it is still moving.The speed is very slow, like walking.

Fifty miles.Su Tang patted Linghe's neck.The spirit crane chirped tiredly, but still sped up.

There are no signs of life on the ice sheet.No trees, no grass, no birds.Even the wind stopped.Everything was silent except for the flapping of the crane's wings and Su Tang's own heartbeat.

Fat Orange poked his head out of the bag and sniffed the air.

Boss, it smells like rust.Very bland, but very fresh.

Su Tang’s heart sank suddenly.

The crane landed on the ice.Su Tang jumped down and slipped on the ice.Shen Yebai held her arm.

There are footprints on the ground - not from a crane, but from a human being.The footprints are not deep, but they are clear, extending towards the north.There are dark red spots next to the footprints.Su Tang squatted down and touched it with his finger - the ice was too thin, and the light from the fragments came up from below and shone on the ice, like blood.What Fat Orange smelled was not the smell of blood, but the smell produced when energy from fragments leaked out, like rust.

Fragments.Shen Yebai's voice was low, and there were fragments under the ice.More than one piece.

Su Tang uses the power of the anchor point to sense.Under the ice, about ten feet deep, there were at least seven or eight pieces scattered.They vary in size, some are like fists and some are like watermelons.They were sealed in ice and did not fall or injure anyone, but the energy was slowly released, warming the ice and causing cracks to appear.

Gu Yan's footprints extended in the direction of the fragments, but they broke off at a certain location - they didn't disappear, but were dragged by something.

Su Tang looked along the drag marks.There was a long, curved drag mark on the ice, as if someone was being dragged forward.At the end of the drag mark was an ice cave—a hole formed by the collapse of the ice. It was pitch black and the bottom could not be seen.

He fell.

Shen Yebai walked to the entrance of the cave, squatted down, and touched the edge of the ice cave with his hands.The edges were wet, with water—not melted ice, but water beneath the ice that had been heated by the energy of the debris.

Su Tang lay down by the entrance of the cave and shouted down: Gu Yan——!

The echo echoed in the ice cave.Once, twice, three times.

Then, a faint voice came from deep inside.Intermittent, like spider silk in the wind.

Su...Tang...?

Su Tang’s fists were clenched, and his knuckles turned white.She didn't cry, but her eyes were hot.

Gu Yan!You wait!I'm coming down to save you!

“Don’t… come down… the ice… is about to collapse…

Gu Yan’s voice was very weak, but he was still trying to speak completely.

The fragments... are down there... a lot... I... picked up... some...

Su Tang stood up and wiped his eyes.She turned to Shen Yebai.

I'll go down.You're on top.

Shen Yebai held her hand.I'll go down.You're on top, using your anchor strength to stabilize the ice.The shards are absorbing energy, and only you can control it.

Su Tang wanted to refute, but Shen Yebai's eyes stopped her.It's not overbearing, it's serious - he has a point.

The ice layer is already very fragile, and after the fragments are activated, they begin to absorb all the energy around them.If Su Tang also goes down, and no one controls the power of the anchor point, the ice will completely collapse.

She nodded, took off the bundle of rope from her waist, and handed it to Shen Yebai.Bai Zhi stuffed the rope into the bag in case it was needed.Angelica is always right.

Shen Yebai tied the rope around his waist and tied the other end around Su Tang's waist.He glanced at her and didn't say don't worry, but just shook her hand gently.

Then he turned around and slipped into the ice cave.

Su Tang lay at the entrance of the cave, watching his white figure getting smaller and smaller in the darkness.Xiaoxue floated out of the sword, holding Su Tang's collar with her little hands, her light blue eyes filled with nervousness.Fat Orange squatted at Su Tang's feet, his tail wrapped around her ankles.The little green dragon poked his head out of his purse, his golden eyes staring at the hole.

Xiaotang, stabilize the ice layer.

The anchor point strength is being entered.The ice structure is strengthening, but the fragments are absorbing energy and are accelerating.

Su Tang knelt on the ice and pressed his hands on the ice.Golden light seeped into the ice from the palm of his hand, spreading around like tree roots.The cracks in the ice stopped growing, and the water at the edges re-frozen into ice.

She could feel Shen Yebai's position in the ice cave - about thirty feet deep.He used his sword energy to carve out a foothold on the ice wall, going down step by step.The sword energy consumed a lot, but he didn't stop.

Fat Orange’s ears stood up.

Boss, the debris below is moving!

Su Tang also felt it.The fragments are not stationary; they drift in the water beneath the ice, swimming like fish.Gu Yan smashed the ice when he fell, and the fragments were activated by the vibration and began to absorb the surrounding energy-including Su Tang's anchor power.

Shen Yebai!The debris is coming to you!
